name: ddl_cost_class_5
oracle_ref: q_ddl.bpf.c:114-115 classify: read && cost<=8 -> DDL_LAT else DDL_BULK; cost == nr_sectors (ioext_bpf_common.h:209); boundary constant Q_DDL_SMALL_SECTOR_THRESH=8 (bpf.c:35). nr=64 reads -> BULK, nr=8 reads -> LAT. :170-227 fresh burst, rules 1-3 cold -> rule 4 drains BULK arrival FIFO, then rule 5 drains LAT arrival FIFO. Assertions on dispatch ISSUE order only.
notes: Cost-boundary case: the two 32KB (nr=64) reads are BULK and issue BEFORE the three 4KB (nr=8) LAT reads even though arrival was interleaved BULK/LAT/BULK/LAT/LAT — only the <=8-sector classification can produce this order. Also anti-C-LOOK: within each lane the order is arrival FIFO (2560 before 3584, and LAT 5120 before 4608 before 3072 = submission order), NOT sector-ascending. expected_merge false: extents non-adjacent (nr=64 spans [2560,2624)/[3584,3648), next read starts 448+ sectors away) and q_ddl allow_merge=false always (bpf.c:340-344).
